libraries.role: LOADED BUT NEVER INITIALISED - DEAD CODE SITEWIDE.
libraries.deadCodeEvidence: window.pJSDom === [] (empty) and document.querySelectorAll('canvas').length === 0 at runtime after load and scrolling. divi-particles.js guards every call with if(jQuery('body').find('#divi-particles-N').length > 0); the only divi-particles-prefixed id in the DOM is id="divi-particles-js", which is WordPress's auto-generated <script> tag id (handle + '-js'), not a container. On a one-page site that means it never runs anywhere.
libraries.wouldBeConfig: The stock particles.js demo preset, unmodified: 100 white circles, line_linked enabled at distance 150 / opacity 0.4, move.speed 6, onhover repulse (distance 200), onclick push (4 particles), retina_detect true. Still carries the generator placeholder shape.image.src: 'img/github.svg'.
